m: बट् ind. in truth, certainly (Sāy. = सत्यम्), RV.
बटू-करण n. the act of making into a youth, initiation of a boy by उप-नयन, q.v., L.
a: बटूकरणं — Investiture with the sacred thread.

m: बटरक n. pl. circular lines of light which appear before the closed eye, AitĀr.
बटु m. (also written वटु) a boy, lad, stripling, youth (esp. a young Brāhman, but also contemptuously applied to adult persons), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
N. of a class of priests, Cat.
a form of Śiva (so called from being represented by boys in the rites of the Śāktas), ib.
a: बटुः — 1 A boy, lad, chap, often used as a depreciatory term or to show contempt; च णक्यबटुः &c.; see वटु. --2 A young Brahmacārin. --Comp. --मात्रः a mere boy.

m: बटु—चरित-नाटक n. N. of a drama.
बटु—दास m. N. of a man, Cat.
बटुकार्चन n. the worship of B˚
बटुक m. a boy, lad &c. = बटु, Kathās.; BhP.
N. of a class of priests, Cat.
a form of Śiva (among the Śāktas), ib.
बटुक—भैरव m. a form of Bhairava, Cat.
बटुक—भैरव—कवच m. or n. N. of wk.
बटुक—कवच m. or n. N. of ch. of wk.
बटुक—नाथ m. N. of a pupil of Śaṃkarācārya, Cat.
बटु—मात्र m. a mere stripling, MW.
बटु—रूपिन् mfn. having the form of a lad or stripling, ib.
बट्टीशी-व्रत n. ‘32 observances’, N. of ch. of BhavP. ii.
